verdict.rationale: Watchlist screening is a fair question for an identity-verification product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers document authenticity checks, selfie matching, SSN and ID-number validation, and manual review tools, but nothing mentions screening against sanctions, PEP, or adverse-media lists. The review-tools blocklist only blocks reuse of the same document and is an adjacent control, not watchlist screening.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can screen verified users against sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media watchlists as part of the same verification — one vendor, one API, one review surface
